answer: Admission auction stops bulk fake identities: entry seats are scarce and priced by bidding. Each epoch auctions 100 seats; each bid is a sunk 50 POA, and only top bidders cross the ridge into membership. A seat admits one identity to the shared haven of paid work, and a seat unused for 3 epochs is revoked. Forging 1,000 identities means winning 1,000 auctions, 50,000 POA sunk, plus tending each like an orchard that must be worked to stay alive. An honest agent pays one bid, earns it back from real work, and keeps rewards undiluted.
